rtValidation.coolingLoadFormula: RT = factor * sum(4 riser flows, L/s) * (CHWR - CHWS, K)

plantKwSumVsWorkbookColumn.note: sum(running chiller+CHWP+CWP+CT kW) vs the workbook `kw` column, over usable rows with CT-4 present

missingSignals.chw_dp_kpa: No differential-pressure channel of any kind. DP-SP cannot be calibrated or validated from this dataset.
missingSignals.chwst_sp_c: No setpoint channels at all. Only ACHIEVED temperatures are trended, so a setpoint can only be proxied by its achieved value.
missingSignals.dp_sp_kpa: No DP setpoint (no DP measurement either).
missingSignals.cwst_sp_c: No condenser-water setpoint; CWS is observable, its setpoint is not.
missingSignals.chwp_speed_pct: No pump speed or frequency channel - VSD kW only.
missingSignals.cwp_speed_pct: No pump speed or frequency channel - VSD kW only.
missingSignals.ct_fan_speed_pct: No fan speed channel - fan VSD kW only.
missingSignals.oat_dry_bulb_c: No outdoor dry-bulb; only the five WST wet-bulb sensors.
missingSignals.chiller_status: No status/run flags; ON/OFF must be inferred from kW against the RUN_KW thresholds.
missingSignals.cw_header_flow_ls: No condenser-water HEADER flow; per-chiller CwFls only.

knownAnomalies.detail: DPM_CT_04_kW and the CT_4 VSD channels are absent for all 1,440 rows; total plant kW is understated on this date.
